description: Make a perfect maze (one path from entrance to exit) up to 60x60, optionally with the solution path. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

answers.description: With format=svg: draw the solution (default false).

markers.description: Draw START and FINISH labels in the SVG (default true).

seed.description: Whole number 0–4294967295. The same seed and options always give the same puzzle; leave it out for a random one (the response tells you the seed it used).

svg.description: Include SVG images of the puzzle and its solution in the JSON (default true).

name: make_maze
title: Make a maze
